question: A parallel plate capacitor is being charged by a time-varying current. A compass needle placed between the plates shows deflection. What is the fundamental physical reason for this deflection?

options.A: Electrons are physically jumping from one plate to the other through the gap.
options.B: The time-varying electric field in the gap acts as a source of the magnetic field.
options.C: The magnetic field from the connecting wires extends into the gap region.
options.D: Air molecules in the gap become ionized and conduct charge.
